sn36.10:1.1: tisso imā bhikkhave vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā.
sn36.10:1.3: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
sn36.10:1.4: sukhavedaniyaṃ bhikkhave phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhā vedanā
sn36.10:1.5: tasseva sukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasamati.
sn36.10:1.6: dukkhavedaniyaṃ bhikkhave phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā
sn36.10:1.7: tasseva dukkhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ dukkhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā dukkhā vedanā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasamati.
sn36.10:1.8: adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ bhikkhave phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā
sn36.10:1.9: tasseva adukkhamasukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā adukkhamasukhā vedanā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasamati.
sn36.10:1.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅkhattā tassa samodānā usmā jāyati tejo abhinibbattati tesaṃ yeva kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvā vinikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasamati.
sn36.10:1.11: evameva kho bhikkhave imā tisso vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā
sn36.10:1.12: tajjaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca tajjā vedanā uppajjati
sn36.10:1.13: tajjassa phassassa nirodhā tajjā vedanā nirujjhatīti.
